component.name: Kurrent Terminal
component.summary: KDE Plasma-native terminal emulator for AI-assisted coding

description.p: Kurrent is a fast, GPU-accelerated terminal emulator built for the KDE Plasma desktop. It uses a Rust-based rendering engine for high performance and a Kirigami-based interface for native KDE integration.

ul.li: Native KDE Plasma color scheme support
KWallet integration for secure credential storage
Plasma Activities support for context-based configurations
Desktop notifications via the freedesktop Notifications interface
GPU-accelerated terminal rendering via Rust and wgpu

description.p: KDE HIG compliance improvements and full KDE Frameworks integration.
